wamyo.title: Wamyō ruijushō (1617 edition)
wamyo.scope: Historical lexicographical commentary. Chinese character explanations do not establish Japanese word ancestry. Transcription generally modernizes character shapes.

tetsugaku.title: Tetsugaku jii (1881)
tetsugaku.scope: Dated terminology and translation attestations; neither first coinage nor borrowing direction is established.
tetsugaku.attribution: Prof. Okajima Akihiro, Osaka University; published by NINJAL

genkai.title: Genkai headword data (1889–1891; dataset 202510)
genkai.scope: Historical headwords and metadata only; dictionary definitions and etymology prose are not included. Linked facsimiles and JapanKnowledge entries are outside this dataset.

nippo.title: Nippojisho headword data (1603; dataset 202510)
nippo.scope: Historical romanized headwords with editorial katakana transcriptions, not full Portuguese definitions. Modernized verb forms are editorial metadata, not historical attestations. Linked facsimiles are outside this dataset.
